notes.lemon: The first sheets used a green lime for «Limón». Catalogue «limón» (siciliano, Amalfi) is the yellow lemon: on integration move photo/lemon.webp to photo/lime.webp and use the new yellow lemon for lemon.
notes.leather: photo/leather.webp is suede (ante/gamuza). Catalogue «cuero» gets its own smooth-leather image (leather_smooth) or keeps the suede.
notes.amber: Perfumery «ámbar» is an accord, not fossil amber: its current drawing of amber stones should become the accord treatment.
